tools.name: check_ip
tools.description: Judge an IPv4/IPv6 address: residential vs datacenter, purity score 0-100, risk-list hits, and whether ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Muse accept its region/type. Data: ipjudge.org.

tools.name: my_exit
tools.description: Judge the public IP this agent/server is calling from (its own network exit) — use it to check whether Claude / ChatGPT will accept the machine the agent runs on.

tools.name: ai_availability
tools.description: Whether ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Muse officially support a country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. US, HK, CN), from each company's published list.

tools.name: service_status
tools.description: Official live status (Statuspage) of Claude, OpenAI, Cursor, GitHub, Cloudflare and more, refreshed every 3 minutes.
